items.headline: Heat Advisory issued September 5 at 2:42AM EDT until September 5 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Heat index values up to 110 expected.

* WHERE...Portions of southeast North Carolina and northeast South
Carolina.

* WHEN...From 11 AM this morning to 8 PM EDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Hot temperatures and high humidity may cause heat
illnesses.
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay out of the sun and in an air-conditioned
room if possible, and check on those more sensitive to the heat.
